title: docs(prs): do not add the "Generated with Claude Code" footer
body:
## The rule

Claude Code appends `🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)` to every PR body unless told not to, and its own instruction defers to a `CLAUDE.md` — so a rule here is the entire mechanism, with nothing to configure per repo or per run.

Brian, 2026-09-21, on PR [slingshot#418](https://github.com/finzeug/slingshot/pull/418): *"it carries the 'generated with claude code' trailer that I want dropped for all"*.

## Why this needed its own change

This is the sibling of the `Co-Authored-By` ban directly above it in the file (issue [dev-common#259](https://github.com/bdh-org/dev-common/issues/259), PR [dev-common#260](https://github.com/bdh-org/dev-common/pull/260), merged yesterday). That rule shipped for **commits** and said nothing about **PR bodies** — same harness default, same override mechanism, a surface nobody wrote down. So the footer kept appearing after the trailer stopped.

## Why it goes HERE and not in one repo's own CLAUDE.md

Measured before choosing, across every open PR in both orgs (17 repos):

```
bdh-org/home-infra   8 of 8 open PRs carry it
bdh-org/dev-common   1 of 1
finzeug/heller       1 of 3
finzeug/panoptikon   1 of 3
finzeug/oleo         1 of 1
finzeug/ratecraft    1 of 1
                    13 total
```

**All 13 are the headless agent's** (`app/bdh-org-coder`); not one is a headful session's. The agent runs with the repo checked out and *does* hydrate submodules (`agent-issue-to-pr.yml`, "Hydrate submodules (per-submodule org tokens)"), so `@common/CLAUDE.md` loads for an agent run. That makes this file the one place reaching both kinds of session — a rule in a single repo would have covered the one case that was not the problem.

Also checked so nobody re-derives it: **nothing in `.github/` emits the footer explicitly.** `grep -rn "Generated with\|claude.com/claude-code" .github/` returns nothing. It is purely the harness default; there is no workflow template to fix instead.

## One deliberate difference from the commit rule

The `Co-Authored-By` rule is forward-looking **only**, because removing it would mean rewriting shared history across 18 repos and invalidating every outstanding branch, PR and pin.

A PR body is **not history**. It is mutable text, editing it notifies nobody, and there is no equivalent cost — so this rule says to strip the footer from an **open** PR when you see it, and to leave **merged** ones alone because nobody reads a merged PR's footer. The 13 above are being edited as part of this work.

## The known lag

`@common/CLAUDE.md` loads from a **pinned** submodule, so merging here reaches no repo until its `common` pin bumps — merged-and-inert, the failure issue [home-infra#1027](https://github.com/bdh-org/home-infra/issues/1027) exists to close. So it is being done in both places, exactly as the `Co-Authored-By` rule was: canonical here, restated in `home-infra/CLAUDE.md` so this seat stops emitting it immediately.

Refs #261
